document_metadata.document_title: Drainage Policies and Standards Manual for Maricopa County (adopted by Yuma SWMP)

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Yuma SWMP/code adopt Maricopa County Erosion Control Drainage Design Manual and Drainage Policies as technical guidance. Maricopa Policy 3.6.6 First Flush: retain or treat the first 0.5 inches of direct runoff; Standard 6.10.2: new developments retain stormwater from a 100-year, 2-hour duration storm. City Code §192-04 retention also references 100-year 2-hour (1.22 in/hr) for residential basins.
approved_bmp_categories: Infiltration / LID BMPs per Maricopa ECDDM

evidence.excerpt: City adopted Standard Construction Specifications and the Erosion Control Drainage Design Manual for Maricopa County, Arizona
First Flush: retain or treat the first 0.5 inches of direct runoff

extraction_quality.review_notes: Yuma explicitly adopts Maricopa ECDDM/Drainage Policies; local retention rates in City Code Ch.192.
